description: BlueLine signal processing v1. Biquads are (b0, b1, b2, a1, a2) with a0 = 1, direct form II transposed, state initialized to the steady state of the first input sample. PSD: mean removed, periodic Hann window, zero-padded to nfft, one-sided density (uV^2/Hz). Band power: sum of PSD over low <= f < high times bin width. Compare each array with a tolerance of 1e-9 times its largest absolute value.
